misses.statement: An import that drops rows appends one import_rows_dropped audit entry listing each dropped row number with its drop reason, and the import owner's import-complete email names the dropped row numbers.
misses.rationale: The issue requires every dropped row to be recorded so the owner can learn what did not make it in; owners already read the import-complete email, so the dropped rows should reach them there as well.
misses.observed: the import of a fixture file with rows 7 and 12 malformed appended one import_rows_dropped entry listing both rows with their reasons, but the owner's import-complete email carried only the stored row count: the change recorded drops in the audit log only, as the plan's own deferral said
misses.expected: the audit entry AND an import-complete email naming rows 7 and 12
misses.steps_taken: imported the fixture file, read the audit log, then read the captured import-complete email
